blocks.x: During this time period, mid-‟50s, then there‟s beginning at least the national recognition of a West Coast style of jazz coming out. I just referenced Chet Baker, Bud
Shank. We talked about Gerry Mulligan. So the pianoless quartet has already been documented. What was the scene like, if you could capture that for us?
Yes, we are, but we needn‟t.
Oh. I thought we were previewing tomorrow.
Oh, okay. How much time do we have, by the way, because I don‟t want to get into something that . . . . Kimery: We can stop right now.
Okay. Let‟s take it up tomorrow.
Yeah. You said you were going to start with something tomorrow, and then we got talking, and I thought we were still on tomorrow.
